name: yspbwx2010-skills
description: yspbwx2010's agent skills, one plugin per skill

plugins.name: miuix
plugins.description: Build Compose Multiplatform apps with Miuix: scaffold, source-extracted signatures, HyperOS visual specs and compile traps

plugins.name: kpm
plugins.description: Write, build and load KernelPatch Modules (KPM): lifecycle, exported kernel API, inline/syscall hooks, aarch64-none-elf build

plugins.name: apm
plugins.description: Build Magisk modules: standard Magisk-style systemless modules as used by APatch — module.prop, the customize.sh install flow, overlayfs systemless /system changes, boot scripts, WebUI

plugins.name: metamodule
plugins.description: Develop a metamodule: the pluggable mount/install backend for KernelSU (and APatch) modules — metamount.sh / metainstall.sh / metauninstall.sh, boot order, source=KSU

plugins.name: mcpp
plugins.description: Use the mcpp C++23 modules build tool: build, test and gate, mcpp.toml field by field, workspaces, toolchains, cross-compilation and bare metal, cache discipline, machine-readable output for CI, contributing to mcpp itself, and packaging a library into mcpp-index.

plugins.name: xlings
plugins.description: Use the xlings package manager: install, remove and multi-version use, SubOS creation and sandboxing, project-mode .xlings.json, custom index repos, mirrors and CN networking, machine-readable output, writing xim-pkgindex packages, and the mcpp/xlings integration.

plugins.name: mcpp-style-ref
plugins.description: Modern/Module C++ (C++23) coding style from the mcpp community's mcpp-style-ref: identifier naming, module and .cppm/.cpp organisation, import std, and everyday idioms (auto, brace init, smart pointers, string_view, optional/expected, RAII).

plugins.name: gki
plugins.description: Build Android GKI kernel modules and make KMI-safe kernel changes (android15-6.6, KMI 8): symbol lists, the MODULE_SIG_PROTECT gate, KCFI-safe callbacks, vendor hooks, kprobes, what a self-built kernel must keep
